'''Cassie''' (Japanese: '''コバシ''' ''Kobashi'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}.

She first appeared in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where she participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] and was [[Geraldo]]'s first opponent. However, she was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament. She made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where she lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]], and [[Freddy O'Martian]].
